findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_facts, open_sound · Private data: get_capabilities, compose_sound, refine_sound, open_sound, read_sound_result, report_sound_feedback, start_tone_conversation, ask_browsertones · Public sink: open_sound, start_tone_conversation, ask_browsertones.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_facts, open_sound · Private data: get_capabilities, compose_sound, refine_sound, open_sound, read_sound_result, report_sound_feedback, start_tone_conversation, ask_browsertones · Public sink: open_sound, start_tone_conversation, ask_browsertones

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
